senses.gloss: (b. h.) to point, move (cmp. b. h. הָדָה).—Denom. יָד.

units: <cite ref="Taanit 6b:16">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>מוֹדִים … לך</he> we offer thanks unto thee.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:3">Ber. V, 3</cite> he who says in public prayer <he>מודים מודים … אותו</he> ‘we thank, we thank’ (as if pointing in different directions and acknowledging two divinities) must be silenced.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:5">Ib. IX, 5</cite> (play on <he>מ̇אד̇ך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:5">Deut. VI, 5</cite>) <he>בכל מ̇ד̇ה ומדה … הוי מוֹדֶה לו</he> for whatever measure He metes out to thee, give thanks to Him. Ib. 54ᵇ <he>ארבעה צריכין להוֹרוֹת</he> four persons are bound to offer public thanks; a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:9">Pes. IV, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 56a">56ᵃ</cite>); <cite ref="Berakhot 10a:23">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>על ג׳ הוֹדוּ לו</he> concerning three of his acts they agreed with him.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 3a">B. Mets. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מוֹדֶה במקצת הטענה</he> he who admits part of his opponent’s claim.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:3">Shebu. VI, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 108b:14">Keth. 108ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>טענו … וה׳ לו בשעורים</he>, v. <cite ref="I00614"><he>טָעַן</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 12b">B. Mets. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>בשחייב מודה</he> when the debtor admits his indebtedness; a. v. fr. [<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:6">Tosef. Par. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 8:6">VIII</cite>), 6 <he>שהן מודין</he>, v. <cite ref="M00653"><he>מוֹרִיר</he></cite>.]
Josh. VII, 19) to confess one’s sins before God.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:8">Yoma III, 8</cite> <he>ומִתְיַרֶּה</he> and confesses in public.

<cite ref="Yoma 40a:3">Ib. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>להגריל ולהִתְוַדּוֹת</he> to cast lots and to make confession (on the head of the scapegoat). Y. ib. VIII, end, 45ᶜ <he>אע״פ שנ׳ בערבית צריך להתודות וכ׳</he> although he has made confession in the evening prayer, he must again confess &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="F00034"><he>וִידּוּי</he></cite>.
